description: This source file contains integration tests for delinquency buckets and related delinquency classification functionalities in the Apache Fineract project. It includes test cases for creating, updating, deleting delinquency ranges and buckets, handling delinquency classification updates via scheduled jobs and inline COB processes, as well as validation for edge cases and negative scenarios.

classes.name: DelinquencyBucketsIntegrationTest
classes.description: Integration tests focusing on delinquency bucket creation, updates, deletion, as well as delinquency classification logic, including scheduled job executions and inline COB processing.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes REST assured specifications and helper instances before each test.

methods.name: testCreateDelinquencyRanges
methods.description: Tests creation of delinquency ranges and verifies they are correctly stored.

methods.name: testUpdateDelinquencyRanges
methods.description: Tests updating existing delinquency ranges and confirms the updates are correct.

methods.name: testDelinquencyBuckets
methods.description: Validates creation and update of delinquency buckets with associated ranges.

methods.name: testDelinquencyBucketDelete
methods.description: Ensures delinquency buckets can be deleted successfully.

methods.name: testDelinquencyBucketsRangeAgeOverlaped
methods.description: Verifies that creating overlapping age ranges within buckets results in a forbidden response.

methods.name: testDelinquencyBucketsNameDuplication
methods.description: Checks that duplicate bucket names are not allowed.

methods.name: testLoanProductCreationWithAndWithoutDelinquencyBucket
methods.description: Tests creation of loan products both with and without associated delinquency buckets.

methods.name: testLoanClassificationRealtime
methods.description: Simulates real-time loan classification based on business date and loan repayment progress.

methods.name: testLoanClassificationRealtimeWithCharges
methods.description: Tests classification when loan charges are added and paid, affecting overdue status.

methods.name: testLoanClassificationOlderLoan
methods.description: Handles classification logic for older loans with overdue installments.

methods.name: testLoanClassificationRealtimeOlderLoan
methods.description: Checks classification updates for older loans with partial payments.

methods.name: testLoanClassificationReversedRepayment
methods.description: Verifies classification updates after reversing a repayment transaction.

methods.name: testLoanClassificationJob
methods.description: Validates the classification process during scheduled job execution.

methods.name: testLoanClassificationStepAsPartOfCOB
methods.description: Ensures classification works correctly when steps are part of the COB process, including inline COB execution.

methods.name: testLoanClassificationToValidateNegatives
methods.description: Tests negative scenarios, such as no delinquency classification for recent loans.

methods.name: testLoanClassificationUsingAgeingArrears
methods.description: Verifies classification logic based on ageing arrears calculations.

methods.name: verifyDelinquency
methods.description: Helper method to verify delinquency data matches expected values.

methods.name: createLoanProduct
methods.description: Helper method to create a loan product with optional delinquency bucket.

methods.name: createLoanProductWithInstallmentLevelDelinquency
methods.description: Helper method to create loan product with installment-level delinquency enabled.

methods.name: updateLoanProduct
methods.description: Helper method to update inArrearsTolerance of a loan product.

methods.name: createLoanApplication
methods.description: Helper method to create a loan application with specified parameters.

methods.name: disburseLoanAccount
methods.description: Helper method to disburse a loan account.

methods.name: createLoanAccount
methods.description: Helper method to create and disburse a loan account.

methods.name: getChargeApplyJSON
methods.description: Helper method to generate JSON for applying charges with due date.
